scripts.db:migrate: for f in db/migrations/*.sql; do psql "$DATABASE_ADMIN_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.db:seed:dev: psql "$DATABASE_ADMIN_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f db/seed/dev.sql && psql "$DATABASE_ADMIN_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f db/seed/dev_history.sql
scripts.db:test: psql "$DATABASE_ADMIN_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f db/tests/attendance_test.sql && psql "$DATABASE_ADMIN_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f db/tests/screens_test.sql
